description: Shows where the current page sits, such as Home › Tour Packages › Gunung Mas. Earlier pages are grey links (navy on hover), the current page is dark.
tip: With a router (React Router, Next.js), use asChild so BreadcrumbLink renders the router's Link component.

separator.title: Custom separator
separator.description: Put another icon inside BreadcrumbSeparator, such as a slash.

collapsed.title: Collapsed
collapsed.description: For a long trail, the middle pages are replaced by "…" that opens a menu.

parts.link: Link to an earlier page. Supports asChild.
parts.page: The current page (not a link), with aria-current="page".
parts.separator: The › between items. Can be replaced by another icon.

props.asChild: Render the child element (e.g. a router Link) with breadcrumb link styles.
props.separatorChildren: Replacement separator icon. Default: right arrow.
props.label: Screen-reader text. Default: "Halaman lainnya".
